Title: Purposive communication. First edition.
Description: Develops your communicative competence and enhances your cultural and intercultural awareness through multimodal tasks. This book was also designed to address the learning needs of students and communicators in today's digital environment.

Title: News for sale : the corruption of the Philippine media.
Place of Publication: Manila : Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism.
Description: Looks at the history of media corruption in the Philippines, probes corrupt practices in the 1990s and discovers how a free press can be bought.

Title: Introduction to mass communication : media literacy and culture. Eleventh edition.
Description: Offers full-semester access to comprehensive, reliable content and learning resources for the Communication course. Connect's deep integration with most learning management systems (LMSs), including Blackboard and Desire2Learn (D2L), offers single sign-on and deep gradebook synchronization. Data from Assignment Results reports synchronize directly with many LMSs, allowing scores to flow automatically from Connect into school-specific gradebooks, if required.

Author(s): Blanco, F. B., Diones, L. L., Escalada-Cordova, M. & Mananay, 	J. A.
Author(s) Full Name:
Felimon Bonita Blanco,
Lito L. Diones,
Monique Escalada-Cordova,
Janet A. Mananay,
Title: Speech and theater arts.
Description: Provides a guide for speech and theater arts students to help develop the skills and techniques that will enable them to become more confident speakers and theater artists.

Title: An introduction to film analysis :         techniques and meaning in narrative film. 2nd edition.
Description: Provides students with instruction in how to analyze film images for the meanings they contain.

Title: Identity and digital communication : concepts,         theories, practices.
Description: Explores the relationship between identity, subjectivity and digital communication, providing a strong starting point for understanding how fast-charging communication technologies, platforms, applications, and practices have an impact on how we perceive ourselves, others, relationships and bodies. It also demonstrates how identity is shaped and understood in the context of significant and ongoing shifts in online communication.

Title: Foundations of data and digital journalism.
Description: Recognizes a growing need for general data knowledge in newsrooms across the globe, including an understanding of what's possible for both data reporting and presentation and how it can be achieved. It also serves as a roadmap for students and working journalists who seek to understand what data is and how to find it; how to harness it most effectively for news; how to think critically about analysis results, potential shortcomings in the data, and the inclusion of appropriate context; and how to present compelling, data-driven stories online.

Title: Guidebook for writers and editors.
Description: Equips the readers with working knowledge about the different aspects of writing. Basic guidelines in simple letter writing, making minutes of meeting, writing research report, and of course, news and feature writing as well as depth reporting in the field of development journalism are thoroughly discussed.

Title: Philippine theater history and genres :         collected essays I.
Place of Publication: Quezon City : Ateneo De Manila         University Press.
Description: Brings two-part collection of theater essays, putting together the two most important illustrative pieces on the historical development of Philippine theater from its earliest beginnings to 2023 and anthologizes comprehensive essays on the principal genres of Philippine theater.

Author(s): Alexander, S., Cooper, G., Diller, B., Greenberg, D., Hauck, T., 	LaRose, M., Roharik, M., Schmidt, D. J. & Walsh-Newton, C.
Author(s) Full Name: Simon Alexander, Grier Cooper, Bill Diller, David Greenberg, Tom Hauck, Melissa LaRose, Matthew Roharik, David Schmidt, Christine Walsh-Newton
Title: The daily book of photography : 365 readings that         teach, inspire & entertain.
Place of Publication: Irvine, CA : Walter Foster 	Publishing, Inc.
Description: Offers a broad look at life through the camera lens. From brief biographies of world-renowned photographers to techniques in fashion photography and trends, there is something for every reader inside. Packed full of inspiring images and stimulating information, this book is a staple for everyone who loves to point and click. Ten categories of discussion rotate throughout the year: History of Photography, Famous Photographers, Photography 101, Fashion & Beauty, Photojournalism, Nature, Portraits, Social Commentary, Innovations, and Photographic Oddities.

Title: Live digital theatre :         interdisciplinary performative pedagogies.
Description: Explores the experiences of interdisciplinary performing arts practitioners working on digital performances and in particular live digital theatre.

Title: Crafting feminism from literary modernism         to the multimedia present.
Description: Develops a dynamic study of craft and art-making in modern and contemporary feminist writing. It also expands our sense of trans artistic modernists scholarship to encompass a process-oriented and medium-specific analysis of textile arts, digital design, collage, photography, painting, and sculpture in literary culture. This book interweaves queer research methods and interdisciplinary rigor with a series of surprising archival discoveries.

Author(s): Gibson, S., Arisona, S., Leishman, D. & Tanaka, A. (Eds.).
Author(s) Full Name: Steve Gibson, Stefan Arisona, Donna Leishman, Atau Tanaka
Title: Live visuals : history, theory, practice.
Description: Surveys the key histories, theories and practice of artists, musicians, filmmakers, designers, architects and technologies that have worked and continue to work with visual material in real time.

Title: Off headset : essays on         stage management work, life, and career.
Description: Contains essays by a richly diverse group of stage management professionals and educators covering the challenges stage managers face of the job, in their lives, and in their careers.

Title: From networks to Netflix : a guide to         changing channels. Second edition.
Description: Surveys the channels, platforms, and programming through which television distribution operates, with a diverse selection of contributors providing thorough explorations of global media industries in flux.

Title: Information visualisation : from         theory, to research, to practice...and back.
Description: "In a world of information overload, this book will help you to cut through the noise and communicate information with clear, efficient, and engaging visualisations. Taking you on a journey through a full range of different types of visualisations including infographics and motion graphics, the book: Explains the underlying principles behind information visualisation, including the science of visual perception and cognition; Provides easy-to-digest guidelines that bring research and best practice together; Showcases a range of real-world applied examples, and outlines the do’s and don’ts of different approaches; Shows how to use research methods to design with and for your target audience. From an expert with years of experience researching, teaching, and doing information visualisation, learn how to make better and informed decisions around visualisation design that are appropriate for both your data and audience." -- Publisher's Description.

Title: Innovating the design process : a theatre         design journey.
Description: Explores the process of designing for theatre and details how each part of a designer's own process, no matter what their design specialization, can be innovated and adapter for a more confident journey and for better outcomes.

Title: Making radio and podcasts : a practical         guide to working in today's radio and audio industries.         4th edition.
Description: Guides anyone who wants to learn how to make successful programmes in the digital era. It examines the key roles in audio and podcasting: announcing, presenting, research, copywriting, producing, marketing, and promotions. It also outlines what is involved in creating different types of programmes: news and current affairs, music, talkback, comedy and features, podcasts, as well as legal and regulatory constraints.

Title: Aftermath.
Description: In 2012, the first African American president is assassinated by a white extremist - just four days after he is elected. The horrific tragedy leads to riots, financial collapse, and ultimately, a full-on civil war. In its aftermath, millions are left homeless as famine and disease spread throughout the country. But from Chicago, a mysterious voice cries out...To Leon Crane, a former NASA scientist now struggling to survive on the streets, the pleas he hears remind him of the wife he could not save - and offer him a chance at redemption. To Jacob Fire Cloud, a revered Lakota medicine man, the voice is a sign that the White Buffalo Woman has returned to unite all the races in peace and prosperity. And to little Amy Ladue, the cries are those of her mother, who disappeared during the devastating St. Louis earthquake - and who must still be alive. These three strangers will be drawn together to rescue someone they have never met, a woman who holds the key to a new future for humanity - one remarkably brimming with hope.

Title: Grimalkin the witch assassin. First Greenwillow paperback edition.
Description: Provides insights into the life of Grimalkin, one of the deadliest witches in the country, if not the world, whose uneasy truce with the Spook's apprentice, Tom, unites them against the ultimate evil of the Fiend.

Title: A feast unknown. First edition.
Description: Lord Grandrith, the fabled jungle lord, is endowed with the gift of eternal life, but with his power comes a gruesome side effect - an abhorrent affliction shared by his nemesis, the formidable Doc Caliban, Legendary man of bronze. Engaged in an epic battle for immortality, the two titans have more in common than they could ever have imagined, but who are the dark manipulators of their destiny?.

Title: Air bound. First edition.
Description: For as far back as she can remember, Airiana Ridell has always been aware of her extraordinary gift. She can intuit revealing and illuminating "patterns" in the air around her - whether in a spray of mist, in billowing clouds or in the dense swirls of an impenetrable fog. Her abilities led to her placement in a secret government training facility when she was a child, but everything changed after her mother was murdered. Airiana fled the program, but she couldn't outrun the desperate members of a shadowy cabal who want her, who need her, who will kill to get her. Kidnapped and held aboard a ship bound for dangerous seas, her only chance for rescue is Maxim Prakenskii. He has his reasons for helping her, but he isn't about to reveal them to Airiana. Not yet. Not as the two are drawn together as moth to flame. not when there are so many secrets yet untold that could shatter the quaint community of Sea Haven and all who reside there...

Title: Dark carousel : a Carpathian novel. Jove         mass-market edition.
Description: The moment Charlotte Vintage walks into his club, Tariq Asenguard's blood is set on fire. The ancient Carpathian had given up hope of finding his lifemate, but now he will do anything to make Charlotte his own. What Tariq doesn't know is that Charlotte is using herself and her best friend as bait - to try to draw out the bloodthristy killers who have already murdered Charlotte's brother and mentor. Charlotte is familiar with Tariq. Not only is he one of the richest and most eligible bachelors in the city, but he's also a renowned collector of old carousel horses, which Charlotte restores. Their shared passion opens Charlotte up to trusting him with her life and with the desire she can no longer control. But it also makes her vulnerable to a centuries-old curse that will unite her and Tariq in a war against the enemies of humans and Carpathians alike...

Title: Deadly game. Jove mass-market edition.
Description: It begins as a mission to protect a politician from an assassination threat. But the operation takes an unexpected turn when Mari, a mysterious beautiful Ghost Walker, is taken hostage. At the same time, Ken Norton, expert assassin and a Ghost Walker warrior, is on a mission of his own - one that reaches into Mari's past. No stranger to the ways of violent warfare, Mari must join forces with ken and trust his every move - each one more intimate than the last.

Author(s): Flint, E., Goodlett, P. & Huff, G.
Author(s) Full Name: Eric Flint , Paula Goodlett , Gorg Huff
Title: 1637 : the coast of         chaos.
Description: The fight for the new world is on! In late 1636, the recently formed United States of Europe makes a private pact with the Netherlands. The USE agrees to create no settlements of its own along the coast north of Pamlico Sound (in what is today's North Carolina) and east of the Appalachian Mountains, and it will not contest the Netherlands control of Manhattan Island and the Hudson valley. In exchange, the Netherlands agrees to abolish slaver in its possessions and to assist the USE in suppressing the Atlantic slave trade. But following shortly thereafter, the long dormant French claims to the British territories they purchased in 1633 from the King of England become active, when new French king Gaston sends troops to invade that portion of North America known today as New England. The American Coast of Chaos is set for explosion that may change the future forever - and liberty and justice for all hang in the balance!.

Author(s) Full Name: Eric Flint and Robert E. Waters
Title: 1637 : the Transylvanian         decision.
Description: The future of Eastern Europe lies in the past. Up-timer Morris Roth and his Grand Army of the sunrise stand at a crossroads. Military success against the Polish-Lithuanian magnates has all but guaranteed a continued push east into Ruthenian lands. There, Roth hopes to further his Anaconda Project so that tens of thousands of Jews are not slaughtered in what's to become knon as the Chmielnicki Pogrom of 1648. But the Prince of Transylvania is thrown into political, social, and religious turmoil as battle lines are drawn. Whatever happens and whoever wins the fight, one thing is certain: the history of Eastern Europe will change radically. In fact, it already has.

Author(s): Flint, E., Carrico, D. & Wentworth, K. D.
Title: The span of         empire.
Description: Fighting genocide on a galactic scale. The Ekhat been terrorizing the galaxy for eons, and if the Jao and their human and Lleix partners are going to have a hope of defeating them, they're going to need some help. To that end, Preceptor Ronz, guardian of Earth and greatest living strategist of the Jao, has sent out an exploration fleet under the command of Caitlin Kralik. But after a long search, all the expedition has found are dead worlds. Do they continue to search down the galactic arm in which Earth and the Jao worlds lie, or do they make an astounding leap in another direction? Meanwhile, the Ekhat have a new generation of leaders growing into power who are even more implacable that those who have gone before them. The Ekhat have not forgotten the Jao, nor the damage they have done over the years to the Ekhat purpose. It's up to the Jao-Human-Lleix confederation and the new allies they make to survive the onslaught and turn the tables on the Ekhat.

Title: Curriculum design and lesson         planning.
Description: Introduces readers to a range of theories and approaches to curriculum development, such as competency-based education and outcomes-based education. This book also focuses primarily upon the design and development of curriculum documents that students will develop skills related to instructional design such as the development of lesson plan for teaching and learning.

Title: Education systems around the         world.
Description: Provides information with regards to different kind of approach to educational system around the world to achieve quality education through learning resources, technology, methodology and operation management.

Title: A value-based education for this century         : new techniques and approaches.
Description: Explores the landscape of value-based education as well as the discussions that are placed in the context of communities that have set priorities for educators and the institutions that employ them.

Title: LET comprehensive reviewer : based on         2022 enhanced table of specifications (TOS) for the board         licensure examination for professional teachers (BLEPT) :         specialization : values education.
Description: Prepares examinees for the licensure examination providing needed materials of different scope of values education competencies to engage themselves with.

Author(s): Lalas, J. W. & Strikwerda, H. L. (Eds.)
Author(s) Full Name: Jose W. Lalas, Heidi Luv Strikwerda, Chris Forlin, Tyrone Howard
Title: Minding the         marginalized students through inclusion, justice, and hope         : daring to transform educational inequities.
Description: While the issue of advancing equity occupies the pages of many education journals across the world and pursuing it in schools and classrooms is a common instructional goal, there is an obvious absence of established school policies combined with pedagogies on how to achieve educational equity. Therefore, equity solution driven by inclusion, justice, and hope is needed to transform the current systemic educational inequities. To ensure and sustain the notion that all children have the opportunities they need to develop, succeed, and meet their potential, it is imperative that we move the discussion about the impact of education from celebrating the academic gain of a few, to the needs of the many marginalized students who are often discounted and dehumanized.

Title: Handbook of education systems in Asia.
Description: Covers many achievements in the region and the difficulties that still exist in education as it explores various ways to respond to changes, revisiting the teaching framework to improve the quality, and establishing support networks for students and teachers.

Title: Theory of modern educational technology and         quality education.
Place of Publication: Wilmington, De U.S.A. : American 	Academic Publisher.
Description: Introduces to the readers with the studying and expounding the modern educational technology theory and the university quality education in order to explore the paths and means to cultivate high-quality talents.

Author(s): Bacus, R. C., Alda, R. C., Dapat, L. C. & Dayagbil, F. T.
Author(s) Full Name: Filomena T. Dayagbil, Lelani C. Dapat, Remedios C. Bacus, Rivika C. Alda
Title: The teaching and assessment of grammar.
Description: Introduces you to the world of teaching and assessment of grammar. It will provide you with enough opportunities that will make you examine the application of the theories and principles in the teaching and assessment of grammar.

Author(s): Bacus, R. C., Terogo, I. J. R., Bustos, R. T. & Dapat, L. C.
Author(s) Full Name: Remedios C. Bacus, Ionell Jay R. Terogo, Roselyn T. Bustos, and Lelani C. Dapat
Title: The teaching and assessment of literature studies.
Description: Intends to assist would-be English teachers in their journey towards the achievement of outcomes related to the actual teaching and assessment of literature studies in the target language.

Title: Professional development and applied ethics.
Description: Tackles the different stages of a person's development process leading to his or her character and personal development to become an effective and efficient individual.

Title: Advanced techniques for collecting         statistical data.
Description: Includes new methodologies based on automatic data collection and analysis systems based on smartphones technology and artificial intelligence, as well as their application in clinical research, sociology, stock market prediction and other fields.

Title: Pork and other perks : corruption 	and governance in the Philippines.
Place of Publication: Quezon City : Philippine 	Center for Investigative Journalism.
Description: Exposes the many facets of corruption in the Philippines and pinpoints who is responsible. But this book goes beyond muckraking to examining the social structures and the institutions that breed graft. It also examines what can be done about it.

Author(s): Delos Santos, D. L. S. & Ng, L. T.
Title: Good governance and         social responsibility. First edition.
Description: Introduces students to corporate social responsibility (CRS) and corporate governance (CG), with theoretical and practical perspectives. Students are made aware of the implications of the effects of business corporation on different stakeholders and the environment, and how these two concepts to organizational success and aid in ensuring long-term business sustainability.

Title: The church of mercy : a vision for the         church.
Description: A magnificent book, bursting with profound spiritual insights, from a man who has quickly become one of the greatest spiritual teachers of our time." --James Martin, SJ, author of Jesus: A Pilgrimage.

Title: Rising to the challenges of leadership.
Place of Publication: Makati, Philippines : Ramos Peace and Development 	Foundation, Inc, 2015.
Description: Shows collection of essays, speeches, and anecdotes of Fidel V. Ramos, former President of the Republic of the Philippines.

Author(s): Te, D. M., Sabanal, D. V., Castro, J. A. & Lelis, C. P.
Author(s) Full Name: Danilo M. Te, Divina V. Sabanal, Jovelyn A. Castro, Christopher P. Lelis
Title: Business research with statistical applications : textbook 	and guidebook for doing and writing research. First 	edition.
Description: Centers on knowing business research, writing business research and applying the statistical tools for the business research.

Title: Inspiration and images : selected speeches         and paintings.
Place of Publication: Makati City : Benigno S. Aquino Jr.         Foundation.
Description: Presents selected speeches and painting of the late president Corazon C. Aquino.

Title: Lolo Jose : an intimate and illustrated 	portrait of Jose Rizal.
Description: Traces the life story of Jose Rizal as culled from family lore and personal anecdotes. Written by Rizal's grandniece, this biography features the most comprehensive photo album of Rizal, along with the complete bibliography of his visual, literary and political works.

Title: Flora de Filipinas. 5th edition.
Description: Contains information obtained from classic botanical texts and other documented sources. The information in this book is provided purely for education and not as a substitute to any established medical or scientific treatment.

Title: Warne, D. P. (2023). Business marketing management in a 	business-to-business context.
Description: Aims to provide a clear, timely, and engaging examination of corporate marketing management. This volume explores some of the most important factors in B2B relationship marketing and their importance to corporate marketing management.

Title: The principles of curriculum development.
Description: Aims to provide materials whose specialization or discipline includes a concern for education. More specifically, the book will be particularly relevant for those that are studying education and its related fields. Policy issues and implications that are discussed in this book may be relevant to anyone that is involved in the provision of social services or even social care. This book has been deliberately written in such a way as to appeal to educationists from all walks of life. Once the methodology and values of the curriculum are acquired, it becomes relatively easy to apply them to specific contexts and needs.

Title: The role of human resource management in 	organizational success.
Description: Aims to those who are generally interested in working people and their experiences in the workplace. This book is useful for undergraduates in a range of management courses. The author tries to locate human resource management within the framework of organizational efficiency while at the same time opening up the department for further scrutiny and appreciation based on its response to the external business environment.

Title: Business environment.
Description: Introduces the readers to the basic concepts of the business environment. It sheds light on the natural and technological environment, business and society, business ethics, the foundation of the legal environment of business, labor legislation, the global environment, and industrial and economic development.

Title: The creation and management of 	database systems.
Description: Provides an overview of the many different aspects of database systems which the content is presented in such a way that even an untrained reader should have no trouble understanding the fundamental ideas behind DBMSs if they read this text.

Title: Management theory and practice.
Description: Provides a comprehensive overview of different aspects of management and their importance in organizations as it examines the historical development of each management school of thoughts, its significance, and its limitations on management practices.

Title: Project management.
Description: Provides broad understanding of project management as it aims to be a resource for academics starting with its fundamentals to central principles of project management.

Title: Exploring data and business management : how 	information helps in supervision.
Description: Takes the readers through several aspects of data management and business management as it sheds light on the several characteristics of data and business management, such as data analysis, big data and business analytics, modern business intelligence (MBI), and data science.

Author(s): Gorton, R. A. & Alston, J. A.
Author(s) Full Name: Richard A. Gorton and Judy A. Alston.
Title: School leadership & 	administration : important concepts, case studies, and 	simulations.
Description: Intends to prepare students for the kinds of situations and problems they will encounter in administrative positions to incorporate key professional standards and competencies (such as the development of skills in communication, group leadership, conflict management, and the like) with action-based research methods and theoretical undergirding to assist in decision-making.

Author(s): Saunders, A., Cornett, M. M. & Erhemjamts, O.
Author(s) Full Name: Anthony Saunders, Marcia Millon Cornett and Otgontsetseg (Otgo) Erhemjamts.
Title: Financial 	markets and institutions. Eight edition.
Description: Brings in a more advanced textbooks on financial markets and institutions, the explanations and illustrations are aimed at those with little or no practical or academic experience beyond the introductory level finance courses. In most chapters, the main relationships are presented by figures, graphs, and simple examples. Updates on the major changes proposed for the regulation of financial institutions are included where appropriate throughout the book.
